Introduction

Toheart was a collaboration duo between SHINee's Key and INFINITE's Woohyun, to signal a collaboration between SM Entertainment and Woollim Entertainment.

In January 2014, following the merger of Woollim and SM in August 2013, it was confirmed that Key and Woohyun were recording for a collaboration, with the album to be out as early as February or as late as April. On February 20, a prologue video was then released, revealing that the unit's name would be Toheart. On March 3, they debuted with their first mini-album, "1st Mini Album."

On April 7, they then released their first digital single "Tell Me Why", which included a broadcasting and acoustic version of the song in the first mini album.

The duo proceeded to disband in 2014.
